vocabulary.meaning: （在战斗、比赛、游戏等中）赢，获胜

examples.text: A friend of mine returned to his house after a holiday, only to find it had been broken into.
examples.translation: 我的一位朋友度假后回家，结果发现家里遭人破门闯入了。
examples.speechText: A friend of mine returned to his house after a holiday, only to find it had been broken into.

examples.text: They were loving, playful animals（animal的复数形式）—like all puppies.
examples.translation: 它们是忠诚又爱玩的动物，就像所有幼犬一样。
examples.speechText: They were loving, playful animals—like all puppies.

examples.text: Machines that can learn are already among us and are changing the world in which we live.
examples.translation: 能够学习的机器已经出现在我们身边，并正在改变我们生活的世界。
examples.speechText: Machines that can learn are already among us and are changing the world in which we live.

examples.text: The area should "have regular classroom time and ideally should be taught as a separate subject," she says, "Children would then have the right context and foundation to get the most out of both the apps and their money."
examples.translation: 她说：“这个领域应该有固定的课堂教学时间，最好作为一门独立课程来教。这样，孩子们才有适当的背景知识和基础，充分利用这些应用，更好地管理自己的钱。”
examples.speechText: The area should "have regular classroom time and ideally should be taught as a separate subject," she says, "Children would then have the right context and foundation to get the most out of both the apps and their money."

examples.text: It is clear she knows what it takes to get young people excited about science.
examples.translation: 很明显，她知道怎样才能让年轻人对科学充满兴趣。
examples.speechText: It is clear she knows what it takes to get young people excited about science.

examples.text: The latter represents（represent的第三人称单数形式） higher levels of comprehension.
examples.translation: 后者代表着更高层次的理解。
examples.speechText: The latter represents higher levels of comprehension.

examples.text: I’d like to reserve a special seat for the concert of May 5.
examples.translation: 我想为五月五日的音乐会预订一个特别座位。
examples.speechText: I’d like to reserve a special seat for the concert of May 5.

examples.text: Forgetfulness can be a normal part of aging.
examples.translation: 健忘可能是衰老的正常表现之一。
examples.speechText: Forgetfulness can be a normal part of aging.

examples.text: Don’t judge them only by their intonation!
examples.translation: 不要仅凭他们说话的语调来评判他们！
examples.speechText: Don’t judge them only by their intonation!

examples.text: No one would deny the usefulness of a world language, but not many people think that Esperanto is likely to play such a role.
examples.translation: 没有人会否认一种世界通用语言的用处，但认为世界语有可能发挥这种作用的人并不多。
examples.speechText: No one would deny the usefulness of a world language, but not many people think that Esperanto is likely to play such a role.

examples.text: Hitler attempted to change the pilots biologically to win the war.
examples.translation: 希特勒试图从生物层面改造飞行员来赢得这场战争。
examples.speechText: Hitler attempted to change the pilots biologically to win the war.

examples.text: This boy is quite intelligent but rather lazy in his study.
examples.translation: 这个男孩很聪明，但学习上相当懒惰。
examples.speechText: This boy is quite intelligent but rather lazy in his study.

examples.text: Many people drink less water in winter, but water is just as important as in summer.
examples.translation: 许多人冬天喝水比夏天少，但水在冬天和夏天一样重要。
examples.speechText: Many people drink less water in winter, but water is just as important as in summer.

examples.text: By the time he retires（retire的第三人称单数形式）, Prof. Baker will have taught in the university for almost forty years.
examples.translation: 等Baker教授退休时，他在这所大学任教就将近四十年了。
examples.speechText: By the time he retires, Prof. Baker will have taught in the university for almost forty years.

examples.text: When I left a 20-year career in the U.S. Coast Guard to become a freelance writer, I had no prospects at all.
examples.translation: 当我结束在美国海岸警卫队长达二十年的职业生涯、转而成为自由撰稿人时，前途一片渺茫。
examples.speechText: When I left a 20-year career in the U.S. Coast Guard to become a freelance writer, I had no prospects at all.
